thread:
Ava (PM): Quick thread — prepping the internal announcement + release-note blurb for the Console cost breakdown feature. Target deploy: Wed 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC. Need ops standby and a pinned model/version. Draft blurb below; please review and add any non-blocking edits. @Ben please confirm rollback thresholds and canary cadence.
Ben (Ops): Ack. I can be on standby for the window. Rollback criteria suggestion: error rate > 2% for 5m OR median p95 latency increase > 35% for 10m. Can do automated rollback via deploybot if triggered.
Riley (Docs): Small copy nit: change "Console cost breakdown" -> "Cost Insights (Console)" in the blurb. Also we should include a link to the short how-to doc. I'll paste a link once the RN is final.
Diego (Eng): CI note — we need to pin model binary to `redwood-models/insights:v2.1.3` for parity with staging. Also confirm migration of KV cache is no-op for this release, right?
Ava (PM): Yes pin to v2.1.3. KV cache: no migration required, runtime will reuse existing prefixes. Adding that to the runbook.
Sam (Oncall): Oncall sign-up: Sam (Oncall) and Ben (Ops) for primary. Secondary: Diego for quick rollback fix. What metrics should trigger pages vs. slack alerts?
Ben (Ops): Pages: incident if deploybot triggers automated rollback OR if error rate > 4% for 10m. Slack alert for degradations (2-4% or latency spike). Sam, I'll add the pager rules to the deploy playbook.
Ava (PM): Draft internal blurb (please iterate):
```
Heads-up: We're releasing Cost Insights (Console) — detailed token-level cost breakdowns and per-route charge estimates.
Launch window: Wed 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC (EU-friendly).
Canary: 5% traffic for 20 minutes, then ramp to 25% for 30 minutes if green, then full rollout.
Pinned model: redwood-models/insights:v2.1.3
Rollback: automated if error rate spikes (see ops thresholds), manual rollback path documented in runbook.
Impact: Read-only analytics surfaces; no DB migrations. Expect small front-end update (feature flag).
```
Diego (Eng): LGTM. One technical ask: add the runtime flag `--kv-prefix=insights-v2` in the deploy command to be explicit.
Ava (PM): Good call — adding that.
Mina (Marketing): Quick ask for internal announce: can we add a single-sentence benefit line for staff bulletin? Something like: "Helps product and finance teams see per-feature token spend in seconds." Will craft a short blurb after final wording.
Riley (Docs): Draft RN snippet (short):
"Cost Insights (Console): View per-route and per-session token spend, with breakdowns by model and prompt segment. This helps SRE/product optimize spend and debug cost regressions faster."
Ava (PM): Nice. Final check: deploybot — schedule staging and prod canary windows.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled -> env:staging at 2026-03-29T22:00:00Z (command: `deploy --service=console-insights --image=redwood-models/insights:v2.1.3 --flags=--kv-prefix=insights-v2`)
DeployBot: deploy scheduled -> env:prod-canary at 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z (5% traffic)
Ben (Ops): I'll run the canary watch. Sam, can you pin the observability dashboard and ensure the alertboard has the thresholds?
Sam (Oncall): On it. I'll add a 5m rolling check for error-rate and a p95 latency monitor. Posting dashboard link in thread in 5.
Ava (PM): Thanks all. Next actions: 1) Ben finalize rollback rules & add to runbook (expected by EOD). 2) Riley + Mina finalize internal blurb and docs link. 3) Diego confirm deploy flags in CI. 4) Sam attach dashboards/alerts. I'll update the RN and send internal announcement once those are green. :thumbsup:
Ben (Ops): Done — I've added the rollback snippet to the runbook and set automated rollback threshold (error rate > 2% for 5m) as discussed. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Riley (Docs): Added docs stub: https://redwood.docs/internal/cost-insights (WIP).
Sam (Oncall): Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/cost-insights (alerts wired).
Ava (PM): Perfect — I'll send the internal announcement at T-minus 6h if no outstanding issues. Final thumbs?
Diego (Eng): 👍
Mina (Marketing): 👍 will prep the staff bulletin line.
Riley (Docs): 👍
